summary: RedHill Biopharma Ltd., through a subsidiary, announced a License and Commercial Supply Agreement with Ferring Pharmaceuticals for exclusive global commercialization rights to Rebyota and exclusive U.S. rights to Clenpiq. Terms include a $12 million upfront payment funded by the earlier $18 million Talicia divestiture, tiered royalties of 5%-20% on net sales, capped milestone payments, deferred inventory purchase, and minimum purchase commitments for 2027-2029. Initial term is 13 years with automatic renewals. Products generated about $37.5 million in 2025 net sales. Ferring retains manufacturing. RedHill assumes exclusive commercialization responsibilities, marking a strategic repositioning of its GI business. Watch for sales ramp and integration execution.
